messages:
rachel: Hey team — looks like the eval dashboard didn't trigger the regression alert for the new quantized Llama test that regressed quality on 1k-checkpoints run. Noticed this when running manual checks.

devon: Wait, the alert is based on the 'eval-quality-drop' metric, right? I saw it in the old grafana dashboard last week.

ana: correct. alert rule -> grafana:eval-quality-drop > 0.07 for 5m. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz/eval-reports?orgId=1

rachel: But the alert history shows it was suppressed last night. says: "suppression policy: eval-report-migration" with a ticket id.

ci-bot: CI/alerts: Suppression applied by automation to group 'eval-reports' at 2026-03-19T22:05Z for deploy migration (ticket #4527).

devon: Who applied that suppression? That was supposed to be timeboxed to 2h. If still on, it explains why we missed it.

ana: I think the suppression was introduced as part of the eval-reports refactor (PR #3110). That PR changed metric names from eval_quality_drop -> eval-quality-drop, but the suppression rule targeted the old name and was translated incorrectly.

rachel: Can we bisect to the PR that introduced the suppression? I ran a quick git log but need a pointer to the deploy that applied it.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed eval-reports service image eval-reports:v1.8.0 -> v1.9.0 at 2026-03-19T22:00Z (cluster-prod-eval). See: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/6578

ana: v1.9.0 corresponds to PR #3110. That PR added a suppression mapping and a transform hook for metric renames. Possibly the transform logic drops alerts during the transition.

soroush: I ran a local replay of metrics through the transform hook and saw a path where metric labels get sanitized to an empty string for suppressed metrics. gist: https://gist.github.com/soroush/0a1b2c

devon: Can you paste the failing snippet?

soroush: ```python
def transform_metric(name):
    name = name.replace('_', '-')
    if name.startswith('eval-') and 'tmp' in name:
        return ''  # intended to drop tmp metrics
    return name
```

ana: That's the bug. During rename the interim name contains 'tmp' and gets dropped. We should not return empty string; instead mark as 'renamed-temporary' and let alerts route.

rachel: OK — short-term mitigation: remove suppression rule and re-enable alerts. Who can revert?

devon: I can revert the suppression mapping in the alert config now. Will do roll-back of just the suppression rule (no code rollback).

ci-bot: CI/alerts: Revert PR submitted: https://ci.redwood.internal/pr/3199 — Revert alert suppression mapping.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Applied alert config change to production at 2026-03-20T00:10Z by devon.

rachel: Confirming — grafana now shows alert firing for the canary traces. Thanks.

ana: Follow-up: we'll patch transform_metric to avoid returning empty string and add unit tests. I'll open a PR and tag @devon for config compatibility checks.

devon: Also add an integration test in the eval CI that runs the rename path and asserts alerts are preserved.

soroush: I'll add the test harness replay to the eval-runner test suite.

rachel: Action items: ana -> fix transform + PR, soroush -> add replay test, devon -> ensure alert config migration tooling is idempotent. Leave suppression off until next safe window.

ana: opening PR now: https://ci.redwood.internal/pr/3201 (fix/transform-no-empty)

rachel: Thanks all. Marking this thread resolved once PR merged and integration test passes. :white_check_mark:
